sentences.show: The first man to fly faster than sound did it with two broken ribs.
It happened on this day in 1947.
The plane was the Bell X-1, a rocket shaped like a machine-gun bullet.
Two nights before the flight, test pilot Chuck Yeager fell off a horse.
Afraid he'd be grounded, he had a civilian doctor tape up his ribs.
But with those ribs, he couldn't slam the hatch shut.
His friend Jack Ridley sawed off a broom handle, to use as a lever.
A B-29 bomber carried the X-1 up, and dropped it.
Yeager had named it Glamorous Glennis, after his wife.
45,000 feet over the Mojave Desert, he flew faster than sound.
The world wasn't told for nearly eight months.
Fifty years later, to the day, he did it again. He was 74.
Also on this day: the Battle of Hastings changed England, and Winnie-the-Pooh first appeared in a book.
